question.problem:
Which of the following integers belong to the residue class $[-6]_{8}?$

I. $18$

II. $-2$

III. $-22$
question.worked_solution:
The residue class $[-6]_{8}$ consists of the elements that are congruent to $-6$ modulo $8.$ So, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}[-6]_{8} & =\{x\in Z\,|\,x≡-6\,(\text{mod}\,8)\} \\  & =\{x\in Z\,|\,x=-6+8k,\,k\in Z\} \\  & =\{-6+8k\,|\,k\in Z\} \\  & =\{…,\,-6-2\cdot 8,\,-6-8,\,-6,\,-6+8,\,-6+2\cdot 8,\,-6+3\cdot 8,…\} \\  & =\{…,-22,-14,-6,2,10,18,…\}.\end{aligned}
$$

We see that $-22$ and $18$ belong to $[-6]_{8},$ while $-2$ does not.

Therefore, the correct answer is "I and III only".
